Fully delivered. Beautifully prepared.
Effortlessly enjoyed.

Luxury caravan hire in Carlisle and Cumbria. We deliver and set up our six-berth Elddis Avanté 866 at your chosen Lake District campsite, and consider UK destinations further afield by arrangement. Your family can simply arrive and enjoy a prepared stay, without towing.
index.html.new:
Tow it yourself or have it delivered.

Our Elddis Avanté 866 is a six-berth towable touring caravan. Collect it in Carlisle for a self-tow holiday, or we can deliver it, set it up and collect it from your approved campsite. Tell us your dates and destination for a quote.

holiday-planner.html.new: Start with your travel dates, the number of guests and the campsite you have in mind. For self-tow, have your tow vehicle details ready.
